build_process_matterport_3d: build a pipeline to process Matterport3D point cloud data into labeled numpy arrays with instance and semantic labels
create_make_mapping: create a category mapping array from a TSV file that maps Matterport3D class names to numeric IDs
run_process_scene: run parallel processing of Matterport3D scenes to extract point clouds, features, and segmentation labels
test_load_ply: test loading PLY point cloud files to extract coordinates, RGB features, and label arrays
summarize_process_pc: summarize processing individual point cloud regions from Matterport3D zip archives into saved numpy files
